messages.subject: Isabella | Global Regulated-Industry Executive | External Affairs, ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Isabella,

I am reaching out because your global Talent Acquisition leadership at Novo Nordisk makes you a relevant point of contact for senior cross-border mandates where public policy, institutional relationships, sustainability and enterprise execution converge.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications in a high-scrutiny multinational operating environment.

Across 12+ years, I have worked in mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. This background fits roles where business strategy depends on regulator engagement, responsible growth, public-private relationships and disciplined stakeholder execution.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Public Policy and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation and expatriate assignments.

I have attached a Novo Nordisk-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable global or regional leadership opportunities.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
